novelty.justification: The novelty route is a new measurement and mechanistic framing: the claim proposes that “multiple independent traits can be co-transmitted up to a capacity limit, beyond which they interfere and mutually degrade,” alongside an effective “bits-per-token rate” and a link between interference and overlapping trait subspaces. Searches using “subliminal learning channel capacity bits per token,” “LLM hidden trait transmission multiple traits interference,” and “subliminal learning entropy soft labels” identified the closest work as Language models transmit behavioural traits through hidden signals in data and Towards Understanding Subliminal Learning: When and How Hidden Biases Transfer; these establish trait transfer, hard-versus-soft distillation, and divergence-token bottlenecks, but do not formulate multi-trait capacity or shared-subspace interference. The step is a substantive multi-part natural extension of existing subliminal-learning and communication-capacity ideas rather than a new paradigm: its changed unit of analysis and multi-trait operationalization exceed a direct object transfer, but the saturation and entropy predictions follow fairly predictably once the established phenomenon is modeled as a noisy channel.
